articles.title: What The Hunting Wives—And The Hunting Wives Alone—Understands About How to Make Addictive TV
articles.summary: This article discusses the full second season of The Hunting Wives. The Hunting Wives , whose second season has arrived on Netflix just in time to distract fans from our feasting families, isn’t so different from TV’s dozens of other soapy thrillers on paper. It’s got sex, murder, secrets, cattiness, betrayal, shameless wealth porn. But so do all the rest. It’s neither the smartest nor the silliest series of its kind. articles.title: What to Know About the Case Behind Netflix's New True-Crime Docuseries The Trials of Karen Read
articles.summary: On Jan. 29, 2022, Boston police officer John O’Keefe, 46, was found dead in the snow outside of his friend’s home in Canton, Mass. His girlfriend, Karen Read , was arrested and accused of second-degree murder and manslaughter, with authorities alleging that she ran over O’Keefe in her SUV while driving under the influence, then left him in the snow to die. articles.title: Breaking Down the Ending of The Remarried Empress
articles.summary: It’s hard to imagine The Remarried Empress appearing on a streamer other than Disney+. The K-drama plays out like a fairy tale. Adapted from a massively successful webcomic and webtoon of the same name, the series stars Hometown Cha Cha Cha ’s Shin Min-a as the empress of a fictional Eastern Empire. articles.title: The Push to Free a Princeton Scientist From ICE Detention Is Growing
articles.summary: Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) detained a Princeton University doctoral candidate on Nov. 19 at an airport in Arlington, Virginia. Her colleagues, classmates, and lawmakers are calling for her immediate release ahead of Thanksgiving Weekend. Eva Yi Xie, a Chinese national, was detained at the Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport as she departed from an annual conference of the Society for Neuroscience.
